readings: Plane stress with the stated E and Poisson ratio.

items.evidence: Sec. 2.1 and Fig. 2 caption specify the plate and material constants; Sec. 2.4 identifies the problem as two-dimensional, without stating the constitutive reduction.

items.description: The stated 1 cm thickness is explicitly assigned to size optimization; the thickness used for the two-dimensional continuum analysis is unspecified.
readings: Use t = 1 cm for topology optimization as well.
Use normalized unit thickness for topology optimization, such as t = 1 mm in N–mm units, and introduce 1 cm only for frame volume calculations.
items.evidence: Sec. 2.1 and Sec. 4.1 assign 1 cm thickness specifically to size optimization; Sec. 2.4 introduces thickness to calculate the frame's available material volume.
